newsitem.title: CHINA: China publishes Hong Kong tycoon's praise of Deng.
newsitem.headline: China publishes Hong Kong tycoon's praise of Deng.

text.p: China's Communist Party newspaper on Friday prominently displayed an article by one of Hong Kong's leading capitalists hailing late leader Deng Xiaoping.
The People's Daily published tycoon Li Ka-shing's praise of Deng for economic reforms that have raised living standards and put China on the path to strength and prosperity.
In the back-page article surrounded with an eye-catching bold-type border, Li said he was saddened by the death of the man whose contributions would be remembered for generations.

He also said Deng had wisely prepared for political succession and that "...under the leadership of the (Communist) party centre with general secretary Jiang Zemin at its core, the international standing of our nation climbs higher with each passing day..."

Li said he was convinced Deng's "one country, two systems" formula, which allows Hong Kong to retain its capitalist system under socialist Chinese rule, had filled the territory's residents with confidence in the future.
The British colony of Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30. China has promised to let it retain its capitalist system for 50 years after the transfer of power.
Li runs the Cheung Kong group of companies which have interests ranging from property to ports and infrastructure development.
Beijing has actively courted Hong Kong's tycoons, needing their investment capital and support for its policies in Hong Kong after the handover.
